# VO Makers

> MirrorVO, LayoutVO and more. Simple iPhone apps that make everyday tasks easier.

VO Makers is an independent studio building simple, useful apps for iPhone. We started with screen mirroring and room planning, and the family keeps growing: more apps, games and desktop tools are on the way.

## Apps

- [MirrorVO](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6799552665): Mirror your iPhone screen to your TV. Mirrors your iPhone wirelessly to a Chromecast TV, to the web browser of a TV without Chromecast, or to another iPhone. With sound, up to 1080p.
- [LayoutVO](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6818802118): Plan your room in 3D, place furniture. Enter or scan your room size, drag and drop furniture, walk through it in 3D and see it in your room with AR. Send a scaled plan and a materials list to your contractor.
- [StageVO](https://vomakers.com/en/#stagevo) (coming soon): See it in your room before you buy. Places a photo of a vase, rug or lamp into a photo of your own room. The product stays exactly as it is; shadow and light adapt to your room. Everything runs on your phone.
- [CallVO](https://vomakers.com/en/#callvo) (coming soon): Block unwanted calls. Blocks a single number or a whole number range; or lets the call ring with a "possible spam" label. Your list stays on your phone.
